Amazon Inspector Code Security adds GitHub Enterprise Server and private connectivity
changes.detail: Amazon Inspector Code Security now supports GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES) integration and private network connectivity for GHES and GitLab Self-Managed. Code Security is also launching automatic fix pull requests in public preview. Organizations that host GHES or GitLab Self-Managed in private networks can now connect through Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (Amazon VPC) configurations or AWS CodeConnections, so they can scan repositories without opening their firewalls to the entire AWS IP address range. changes.title: Amazon S3 Tables now support promoting replicas to writable tables
changes.detail: Amazon S3 Tables replication now lets you make a read-only replica of your Apache Iceberg table a standalone, writable table with a single API call. S3 Tables replication keeps read-only replica tables in sync with your source tables across table buckets, AWS Regions, and accounts. Instead of copying a replica into a new table, you can promote it in place to move writes to another Region. When you disassociate a replica from replication, the standalone table keeps its namespace and table name, so your queries and pipeline code carry over when you point your applications at it. changes.title: Compute Engine: Feature (November 18, 2026)
changes.detail: Preview : C4D bare metal instances support the creation of up to 10 network interfaces per instance. Preview : Two new C4D bare metal machine types are also available. These machine types provide 12,000 GiB of Titanium SSD and up to 200 Gbps network bandwidth with per VM Tier_1 networking performance: c4d-standard-384-lssd-metal c4d-highmem-384-lssd-metal For more information, see C4D machine series .

changes.detail: Using System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) data as the source for both user and group claims ( enabled-for-users-groups mode) in Workforce Identity Federation is generally available for Gemini Enterprise and Looker across web sign-in and OAuth sign-in workflows.
